'''Star Tours Flight 901''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Rafa V]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight was on time and scheduled to arrive at Gate 1M at 1025 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1120.
